newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Thursday, with healthy gains in Malaysia failing to lift local values, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. They said palm oil was higher at 1,259 rupiah/kg at a 1,000-tonne tender.
"The market fails to follow the increase in Malaysia. Local prices are still under pressure because of the market operations by (state logistics agency) BULOG," said one trader.
They said the relatively high price of crude palm oil was keeping margins on olein slim to negative.
Traders said state logistics agency BULOG was continuing with its market operations, selling olein at 1,435 rupiah.
"We hope the market to be active again after the Eid al-Fitr celebrations next month," said one trader.
Data from Belawan Port showed that KM Marina 33 will unload 950 tonnes of refined olein and load 1,000 tonnes of palm olein in Tanjung Priok.
